migrate.skip.dup: {head} — was not in effect: a second rule for the same port. Will remove it.
migrate.skip.dup_k3: {head} — duplicate: Kaskad 3 already handles this port ({winner}). Will remove it from iptables.
migrate.skip.key_kept: {head} — a rule that stays covers this port. Will leave it as is.
migrate.skip.partial: {head} — a rule with conditions ({conditions}), and there are other rules for this port: which one applies depends on the traffic. Will leave it as is.
migrate.skip.partial_before: {head} — works for part of the traffic only (a rule with the condition {before} comes earlier) — will leave it as is.
migrate.skip.shadowed: {head} — was not in effect: another rule takes the port earlier ({winner}). Will leave the rule as is.
migrate.skip.shadowed_docker: {head} — was not in effect: Docker takes the port earlier. Will leave the rule as is.
migrate.skip.target: {head} — Kaskad 3 does not forward to such a target ({target}). Will leave it as is.
migrate.skip.unreachable: {head} — the rule does not apply to the addresses of this server ({conditions}). Will leave it as is.
